title: GOOD: adding stoa-auth to workspace members was a bug fix
description:
## What

aubi.1 added crates/auth to the [workspace.members] list in the root Cargo.toml. Before this change, stoa-auth existed on disk at crates/auth, was a dependency of 5+ crates, but was not listed as a workspace member.

Confirmed by: git show 6afac20:Cargo.toml shows no crates/auth entry, while the current Cargo.toml has it at line 4.

## Why good

A crate depended on by 5+ workspace members but absent from [workspace.members] is silently skipped by:
- `cargo test --workspace`
- `cargo clippy --workspace`
- `cargo fmt --all`
- workspace-level `cargo build --workspace`

This means stoa-auth's own tests were never running in CI, and clippy/fmt were never applied. This is a correctness hazard, not just a convenience issue: a bug in stoa-auth's CredentialStore (e.g. the bcrypt timing oracle or the plaintext-password panic) could exist undetected.

The issue description correctly identified this as a pre-existing bug and framed the workspace member addition as a correctness fix, not just a housekeeping change.

## Alternative avoided

The alternative (leaving it off the workspace members list and only fixing the duplicate) would have silently continued skipping stoa-auth in all quality-gate commands.
